bioParagraphs: Max Rivera (b. 1989) is a mixed-media painter based on the Kent coast. After a decade working in set design, they turned to painting full time in 2019.
Their work layers acrylic, found paper and household paint, building surfaces that echo weathered walls, rusted railings and sun-bleached signage.
Recent exhibitions include group shows in Margate and London; their studio overlooks Whitstable harbour, which supplies much of the subject matter.
statement: I am interested in the way places keep their own records — salt in brickwork, paint peeling in the same spot year after year. My paintings try to slow that record down and hold a single moment of light still.
